title: Multi-indicator Multi-TF Dashboard (10 pairs)
entry_long: EMA5>EMA13 + RSI>60 on multiple timeframes (M5, M15, M30, H1, H4)
exit: manual via dashboard buttons (close all, close profit trades, close loss trades)
buildon_idea: baseline educational example; extend with automated entry/exit; add per-symbol SL/TP tuning
novelty_note: admin tool, not trading strategy; demonstrates multi-pair multi-TF infrastructure only

title: Semi-Auto Buy/Sell with FL Train & Reverse Train
entry_long: manual user button press for buy; system detects direction after entry
entry_short: manual user button press for sell; system detects direction after entry
exit: cumulative profit target (dynamic formula based on position count) or trailing stop
buildon_idea: add ATR-based position-sizing cap; replace martingale with linear-add lot law; implement fixed SL on first entry
novelty_note: semi-auto UX novel but mechanism is standard grid+martingale

title: Semi-Auto Multi-Mode Grid (FL Train + Reverse Train)
entry_long: manual user entry; if price rises: FL Train opens grids every 100 pips; if price falls: RT Train (recovery)
entry_short: manual user entry; mirrors buy logic downside
exit: trailing stop (500 pips, 100-pip steps); cumulative profit exit when target hit
buildon_idea: add position-size cap per trade; replace martingale with linear or log-add; add ATR-adaptive stop-loss
novelty_note: semi-auto + dual-mode is standard grid evolution; trailing stop novel for smaller TFs

title: Multi-Group Reversal Candle Grid (Buy/Sell separate)
entry_long: ID3=bearish, ID2=bullish, ID1=bullish (reversal up) + RSI<30 + Stochastic<20; group 1 isolated
entry_short: ID3=bullish, ID2=bearish, ID1=bearish (reversal down) + RSI>70 + Stochastic>80; group 2 isolated
exit: trailing stop (20 pips) when count>=2; tailing step 1 pip; adaptive to ATR
buildon_idea: add position-count trigger delay; test ATR-adaptive entry distance; combine 2 groups into single-symbol pair trade
novelty_note: reversal candle is well-known; grid + trailing stop standard; multi-group isolation adds complexity but improves SL control

title: Multi-Group Reversal Candle Adaptive Grid (XAU)
exit: trailing stop (20 pips, step 1) adaptive to ATR; cumulative profit exit (dynamic per position count)
buildon_idea: test on other precious metals; add symmetry check (same lot scaling both groups); combine into hedged pair
novelty_note: reversal + Stochastic filter + ATR adaptation is solid; multi-group isolation proven in backtest (5.13% DD, 22.6% gain)

title: Multi-Group Doji Grid (Buy/Sell isolated, FL+RT modes)
entry_long: doji (low wick >50% of candle size, body small) + RSI<30 on ID1; group 1; triggers FL Train
entry_short: doji (upper wick >50%, body small) + RSI>70 on ID1; group 2; triggers FL Train
exit: trailing stop (dynamic, ATR-adapted) when count>=2; RT Train (recovery) on loss; cumulative profit exit
buildon_idea: reduce doji sensitivity (30-50% body ratio too strict); test on 4H + daily; add fixed SL at 2x ATR
novelty_note: doji is common, RSI filter standard, but ATR-adaptive scaling is robust; backtest 518 trades, 22.6% gain, 5.13% DD

title: Multi-Group Grid with Pattern + RSI (FL/RT + Tailing)
entry_long: uptrend candle (small lower wick, large body) + RSI>30; group 1; FL Train escalates every 15 pips
entry_short: downtrend candle (small upper wick, large body) + RSI<70; group 2; FL Train escalates every 15 pips
exit: tailing stop (ATR-adaptive) starts at count>=2; cumulative profit target (dynamic per count); RT Train on loss
buildon_idea: parameterize body/wick ratio (currently 80/10); test multi-symbol portfolio; add position-age filter (close oldest first)
novelty_note: pattern recognition + ATR sizing is standard grid evolution; multi-group isolation improves DD control

title: Gold Robot using Single Candle Template (Doji + RSI)
indicators: Single Candle Template (doji: lower wick >50%, body <10%)
entry_long: doji (lower wick >50%) + RSI<30; opens buy, escalates every 100 pips
entry_short: doji (upper wick >50%) + RSI>70; opens sell, escalates every 100 pips
exit: combined P&L (both buy+sell) reaches 5 USD cumulative; closes both groups simultaneously
buildon_idea: replace fixed 5-USD target with dynamic (ATR-based or position-count formula); test on XAU crosses (XAUJPY); add per-group SL
novelty_note: Single Candle Template block is FX DMA tooling; hedged pair exit (close both groups together) novel for rig risk; backtest 6 days, ~20% gain
